items.one_liner: Use this open-source utility to test and verify proxy configurations for authenticated access to Google AI Studio and Gemini.
items.summary: Gemini-Config-Checker (version 0.1.0) is a newly released pre-release utility designed to identify proxy configurations that successfully grant access to Google AI Studio and Gemini via a signed-in browser. Because plain HTTP requests cannot accurately determine geo-restrictions applied post-load by Google accounts, the tool tests each route inside a browser environment. It provides native support and pre-compiled builds for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android, though the Android build runs in connectivity-only mode due to platform limitations preventing automated Chromium sign-ins.
items.bottom_line: This tool tests proxy configurations inside a signed-in browser to accurately verify region availability for Google AI Studio and Gemini.

items.summary: RESX is a new open-source Windows binary analysis and reverse engineering toolkit designed to streamline malware analysis workflows. The tool provides advanced capabilities including API deobfuscation, argument recovery, and kernel IOCTL reconstruction. It allows analysts to generate call graphs of Windows API's and internal functions quickly, often revealing significant functionality without the need for a full disassembler. RESX is specifically built to handle modern malware techniques, packer identification, and hypervisor-aware driver analysis.

items.one_liner: TwinFix offers a structured, agentic approach to automated bug fixing that prioritizes safety through isolated verification and human-in-the-loop approval.
items.summary: TwinFix is a new AI agent designed to automate the diagnosis, reproduction, and repair of software bugs within isolated, disposable 'twin' environments. Unlike existing AI SRE tools that focus primarily on diagnosis, TwinFix modifies business code and verifies the fix against hidden tests before submitting it for human approval. The system supports multiple languages including Java, Python, Go, and TypeScript, and integrates with CI/CD pipelines using Docker Compose or Kubernetes. It enforces a strict workflow: diagnosis, reproduction in a twin environment, repair, independent verification, and final human review.
key_facts: Supported languages: Java, Python, Go, TypeScript, C#
items.bottom_line: Automated code repair agents are moving toward 'twin' environment validation, which significantly reduces the risk of deploying faulty AI-generated patches.

items.title: CVE-2026-0330 PAN-OS: Authenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Panorama (Severity: MEDIUM)
items.one_liner: An authenticated RCE vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Panorama PAN-OS allows root-level code execution.
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks has disclosed CVE-2026-0330, an authenticated remote code execution vulnerability in PAN-OS software running on Panorama. The flaw enables an authenticated administrator with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the device. Cloud NGFW, Prisma Access, and standalone firewalls remain unaffected. Palo Alto Networks noted that the risk is significantly minimized by restricting management interface access to trusted internal IP addresses and jump boxes. While no malicious exploitation has been reported, the vendor rated the issue medium severity and urged prompt remediation.
key_facts: Product: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS on Panorama
items.bottom_line: Authenticated administrators can achieve root-level remote code execution on vulnerable Panorama appliances running affected PAN-OS versions.
